messages.subject: Power vs effect size
parts:
Hello,

I would like to refer to the attached figure from a secr course in a paper and would like to reference it properly. Please let me know what reference is best.
Thank you,
Michelle

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Power vs effect size
parts:
Hi Michelle
I guess this is addressed to me as the originator of that plot. There is no citeable reference. I am working on software (unfortunately it didn't make it into the just-released version of 'secrdesign') and a possible publication. I would now routinely adjust for the likely change in RSE with density (less power when density declines, more when it increases), and there are refinements (= corrections) to the equation for lognormal effect size. That gives this plot, which matches simulation results where I have tested it. Curves are for the power of a 2-sided test (alpha = 0.05) for change between two surveys given different levels of the initial RSE(D-hat); RSE(final D-hat) is scaled by sqrt(D2/D1). This needs to be properly reviewed before people start relying on it.
Murray
